thread:
anya: quick heads-up, PR for the 'Error Reference: 429s & Timeouts' section tripped snippet CI. The examples that detect 429 vs stream EOF are flaky across SDK versions. PR: https://git.redwood/infr/docs/pull/499

rachel: which snippet output differs?

anya: the Node retry sample. CI shows `Stream ended unexpectedly` in one run and `429 Too Many Requests` in another. Makes the narrative about retry decisions confusing.

samir: runtime note: sometimes the server closes the stream instead of returning 429 when under heavy load. Docs should show both checks (status === 429 || isStreamEOF(err)) and recommend preferring Retry-After header when present.

rachel: agree. propose adding a tiny helper `shouldRetry(err)` and a short test harness simulating both behaviors. Keeps the prose compact.

docs-bot: snippet-lint: 1 mismatch. See CI: https://ci.redwood/infr/snippets/499

anya: ok. rachel, can you add the helper + a 3-case micro-eval (immediate 429, stream EOF, success)? samir can paste canonical helper if needed.

samir: helper suggestion:
```
function shouldRetry(err) {
  return err?.status === 429 || err?.code === 'STREAM_TRUNCATED'
}
```

ci-bot: holding snippet publish until micro-eval added and outputs stabilize.

rachel: will add micro-eval and update PR today. tagging @anya for review once added.

anya: thanks — once snippets pass, I'll update the runbook link to the consolidated error-ref entry.
